titulo: The conditional to express probability about the past
subtitulo: ¿A qué hora llegaría? Serían las tres.
regla: The conditional simple can express a guess about the past: Serían las tres = It was probably three. ¿Dónde estaría? = I wonder where he was. For a known fact, use the preterite or imperfect. For a guess about the present, use the future.

bloques.texto: Besides _would_, the **conditional simple** can express a **guess or speculation about the past**: what you think **probably** happened or was the case.

filas: Llegaría a las tres. (_He probably got in at three._)
Serían las siete. (_It must have been seven._)
Tendría veinte años. (_She was probably twenty._)

bloques.texto: As a question, it means _I wonder..._: **¿Dónde estaría?** = _I wonder where he was._
For a guess about the **present**, use the **future**: **serán las tres** (_it's probably three_).
Tip: future guesses about now, conditional guesses about then. Move one step back in time.

lista.es: —Son las once y Antonio sigue dormido.
lista.en: —It's eleven and Antonio is still asleep.
—I wonder what time he got home last night.

lista.es: —Yo creo que ==llegaría== como a las tres.
lista.en: —I think he probably got in around three.
I wonder what time the bus left.

lista.es: ==Serían== las siete cuando por fin terminó la junta.
lista.en: It must have been seven when the meeting finally ended.
We were probably ten in that photo.

lista.es: La última vez que la vi, ==tendría== unos veinte años.
lista.en: The last time I saw her, she was probably about twenty.

lista.es: Ustedes todavía ==vivirían== en Bogotá cuando tomaron esta foto, ¿no?
lista.en: You were probably still living in Bogotá when you took this photo, right?

filas.t: Ahorita estaría en casa. (guess about now)

lista.texto: Guessing about the present: [[5060|future of probability]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: Guess about the past: _It was probably midnight._
In Spanish: _I wonder who called yesterday._
Guess about the present: _She's probably at work._
